description: Reference native toolchain for the C broker. The reference build identity is the SHA-256 of the binary produced by this exact compiler, flags and libzmq, with the C runtime start files and libgcc of the GCC installation that clang selects (the newest installed GCC).

reference_build.gcc_runtime: GCC 13 (Ubuntu libgcc-13-dev, the clang-18 dependency); with gcc-14 installed clang selects GCC 14 and the binary differs
